title: Recycled anisotropic Nd-Fe-B LPBF bonded magnet literature baseline
scientific_scope: recycled rare-earth-containing Nd-Fe-B powder bonded with PA12 and fabricated by LPBF

source.citation: K. Schäfer et al., Fabrication of Sustainable 3D Printed Anisotropic Bonded Magnets Using Recycled Nd-Fe-B Powder and Low CO2 Footprint Polyamide 12
source.raw_data_availability: supporting data available from corresponding author on reasonable request
source.benchmark_admission_note: Values in this file are transcribed from the paper; they are not raw observations acquired by Luminous Dynamics.

powder_hysteresis.specimen_preparation: powder embedded in epoxy and aligned using a 1 T permanent-magnet field

printed_composite_magnetization.correction_note: The source reports N=0.2 in its measurement description. A new study must independently establish correction applicability for its exact specimen geometry and method.

alignment_metric.name: mean_cos_theta
alignment_metric.caution: Preserve this source definition for reproduction; do not silently substitute a different texture metric.

reported_comparison.comparability: source-reported approximate relative gap only; do not infer an absolute comparator value or claim a matched comparison
reported_comparison.coercivity_comparison: paper describes composite coercivity as within the range of commercial anisotropic bonded magnets; exact matched grade data not encoded here

authors_identified_research_directions: optimize mixture ratio of smaller and larger particles to balance densification and particle alignment
optimize layer height to balance densification and geometric alignment
investigate a homogeneous fabrication magnetic field to improve particle alignment
reproduction_requirements: obtain supporting raw data if available from authors
verify exact powder lot, composition, PSD method, morphology and build history
match specimen geometry, magnetization direction, temperature, applied field and demagnetization correction
preserve all attempted builds and failed or excluded specimens
report source transcription uncertainty separately from new measurement uncertainty

source_transcription_notes.input_policy: do_not_treat_either_scalar_as_the_exact_full_particle_size_distribution; obtain full PSD or preserve uncertainty
